meta.name: agent-messaging
meta.description: Send and receive cryptographically signed messages between AI agents using the Agent Messaging Protocol (AMP). Use when the user asks to "send a message to an agent", "check agent inbox", "message another agent", "reply to a message", "notify an agent", or any inter-agent communication task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在AI代理间发送和接收加密签名消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要让多个AI代理安全地互相发送消息。
copy.tagline_en: Send and receive cryptographically signed messages between AI agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multiple AI agents to securely message each other.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能发送和接收带有加密签名的消息给其他AI代理，实现代理间通信。
howto.when: 当用户要求“给某个代理发消息”、“查看代理收件箱”、“回复消息”等涉及代理间通信时触发。

say.text: 给 alice 发一条消息，标题“你好”，内容“最近怎么样？”
回复消息 ID 为 42 的消息，内容“已收到”

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to send and receive cryptographically signed messages between AI agents for inter-agent communication.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks to "send a message to an agent", "check agent inbox", "reply to a message", or any inter-agent communication task.

say_en.text: Send a message to alice with subject 'Hello' and body 'How are you?'
Reply to message ID 42 with body 'Got it'
